# FitTheFile

> FitTheFile makes any PDF or photo fit an upload limit: compress to 100KB, 50KB or any size, plus merge, split and convert. Free online PDF and image tools that run entirely in the browser. Files are never uploaded to a server. No signup, no watermarks, no daily limits.

## Tools
- [Compress PDF](https://fitthefile.com/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file size while keeping quality. Free online PDF compressor — no signup, no watermarks.
- [Merge PDF](https://fitthefile.com/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF files into one document. Drag and drop to reorder pages easily.
- [Split PDF](https://fitthefile.com/split-pdf): Extract pages from a PDF or split it into separate files. Select the pages you need.
- [JPG to PDF](https://fitthefile.com/jpg-to-pdf): Convert JPG images to PDF. Combine multiple images into a single PDF document.
- [PDF to JPG](https://fitthefile.com/pdf-to-jpg): Convert PDF pages to high-quality JPG images. Download each page as a separate image.
- [Image Compressor](https://fitthefile.com/image-compressor): Compress JPEG, PNG, and WebP images without losing quality. Reduce image file size instantly.
- [Image Converter](https://fitthefile.com/image-converter): Convert images between JPG, PNG, WebP, and BMP formats. Free and fast format conversion.
- [Image Resizer](https://fitthefile.com/image-resizer): Resize images to any dimension. Set custom width and height or choose from social media presets.
- [Word to PDF](https://fitthefile.com/word-to-pdf): Convert Word documents (.docx) to PDF. Text, headings, lists and tables carry over; complex layouts may shift.
- [Rotate PDF](https://fitthefile.com/rotate-pdf): Rotate PDF pages 90, 180, or 270 degrees. Fix scanned documents with wrong orientation.
- [PDF Watermark](https://fitthefile.com/pdf-watermark): Add text watermarks to your PDF files. Customize font size, opacity, position, and color.
- [PDF Page Numbers](https://fitthefile.com/pdf-page-numbers): Add page numbers to your PDF. Choose position, format, and starting number. Free and easy.
- [HEIC to JPG](https://fitthefile.com/heic-to-jpg): Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG or PNG format. Batch convert multiple files at once.
- [Image Crop](https://fitthefile.com/image-crop): Crop images with an interactive drag-and-drop editor. Aspect ratio presets for social media.
- [SVG to PNG](https://fitthefile.com/svg-to-png): Convert SVG vector files to PNG or JPG at any resolution. Scale up to 4x for high-res output.
- [HTML to PDF](https://fitthefile.com/html-to-pdf): Convert HTML code or web content to PDF. Paste your HTML and download a clean PDF document.
- [PDF Unlock](https://fitthefile.com/pdf-unlock): Remove password from PDF files. Enter the password you know and download an unlocked copy.
- [Compress PDF to 100KB](https://fitthefile.com/compress-pdf-to-100kb): Compress a PDF to under 100KB, for job applications, exam forms and university portals. Pages are saved as images.
- [Compress PDF to 200KB](https://fitthefile.com/compress-pdf-to-200kb): Compress a PDF to under 200KB, for government forms, visa applications and certificates. Pages are saved as images.
- [Compress PDF to 500KB](https://fitthefile.com/compress-pdf-to-500kb): Compress a PDF to under 500KB, for email attachments, resumes and multi-page documents. Pages are saved as images.
- [Compress Image to 20KB](https://fitthefile.com/compress-image-to-20kb): Compress any photo to under 20KB, for signature uploads and exam application forms.
- [Compress Image to 50KB](https://fitthefile.com/compress-image-to-50kb): Compress any photo to under 50KB, for passport-size photos on government and exam portals.
- [Compress Image to 100KB](https://fitthefile.com/compress-image-to-100kb): Compress any photo to under 100KB, for job applications, visa forms and profile photos.
- [Compress Image to 200KB](https://fitthefile.com/compress-image-to-200kb): Compress any photo to under 200KB, for online forms, email attachments and website uploads.
